name: As permitted, DP issued 5 Feb 2025: 29-storey social housing tower (under construction, completion 2029)
proponent: City of Vancouver (Non-Market Housing Development and Operations) with BC Housing; operator BC Indigenous Housing Society
rezoning_path: False Creek North ODP and CD-1 amendments approved after the 13 Jul 2023 public hearing; development permit through the SHORT program
notes: Storeys, height, floor area, FSR and the 299 units are the City's application figures; 63 vehicle and 536 bicycle spaces, 112 family units and 15 accessible units are the architect's published figures. The bedroom mix is not public, so the unit counts are left null and the engine marks the family-unit rule uncertain; the referral report required 20% of units (60) at shelter rate but the share below HILs is not published. Setbacks and the 3.05 m floor-to-floor (88.4 m over 29 storeys) are placeholders for the massing only. Funding on the public record: federal Affordable Housing Fund and provincial Community Housing Fund (amounts reported jointly with 450 Pacific St) plus City DCC waivers and land.
